items.title: Questions are part of safe medicine use.
items.body: You never need to apologise for asking a pharmacist to explain something again.

items.title: Keep a current medicine list.
items.body: Include prescribed medicines, over-the-counter products, supplements, and allergies if known.

items.title: A lot of Pharmacy work happens before you arrive.
items.body: Planning, checking, storing, preparing, and communicating all protect the patient at the final counter.

items.title: Storage is part of the medicine.
items.body: Follow the label or pharmacist’s advice, and keep medicines away from children when appropriate.
